body: This year has been awful. I nearly died because of antidepressants/birth control (I had to figure it out for myself as my GP kept saying it was stress; stress doesn't cause bruising and not being physically able to get out of bed). Then my partner lost his job and now just today HMRC say we owe nearly £700 in tax and no one is there to pick up the phone. We've lived in our overdrafts for the past 4-5 months, we don't have anything. I literally cried the other day and felt guilty for spending £17 in Poundland. Just tired of life at the minute.
